**Given:**

The number of officers working in six companies (table).

**Formula used:**

Total number = sum of all individual officers from each company.

Total number = n(D) + n(E) + n(F) + n(G) + n(H) + n(I)

**Calculation:**

Let, Officers, working in a certain company = n()

Total number of officers working = n(D) + n(E) + n(F) + n(G) + n(H) + n(I)

⇒ 400 + 500 + 600 + 350 + 450 + 800

⇒ 3100

Thus,** '3100' number of officers are working in all the companies.**
